author: haiku
label: climb-05-01
changes: Reordered the document into the required layout: a summary paragraph first, then terms, the choices, the diagram with its notes, the failure table, and open questions at the end.
Added a summary that says how the current system works (no sign-in, all pages public) before describing the change.
Defined every term a newcomer needs in one plain line, including sid, cookie attributes, TTL, bcrypt, dummy hash, Lua script, fail closed, Retry-After and NTP.
Kept every choice from the original table and added the logging row, so each choice is stated explicitly as the brief requires.
Kept the Mermaid sequence diagram in its original form, changing one label so the protected-request Redis error reads '503 with Retry-After, cookie kept', which matches the failure table.

Moved the rules that do not fit on the arrows into notes after the diagram, grouped by login, protected request and logout, each saying what starts it, what it does, where its data lives and what happens on failure.
Gave a one-clause reason for each rule where it appears, such as why the old session is deleted on login and why the password is not checked when Redis fails.
Merged the session-state rules and the expiry-clock rule into one short list, and cut the duplicated Responses and Logout rule text.
Cut the long 'Why Redis' argument to a shorter paragraph that keeps the reason and the cost. Kept the open boundaries, reworded as open questions, and kept the unresolved Redis-restart decision.
Added the 150 ms Redis timeout to the notes so it appears where a reader needs it, not only in the failure table.
